items.summary: Fleet recommendation: preserve containment-only execution until one delivery slot is released and existing repair, measurement, security-evidence, and readiness work is resolved. Highest-leverage product investment is execution integrity: consolidate duplicate work, link every approved proposal to one routable request, and automatically surface stranded or overlap-blocked items. This targets 108 approved proposals without execution, 164 stranded work items, 10/10 delivery slots occupied, 21 failed requests, and a 63% approved-proposal execution rate. No new production work, telemetry, spend, credentials, schedules, or deployments are recommended this cycle. Keep the existing CTA candidate slot-gated and retain current private launch gates.
